children: XRPUSD saw renewed trader interest: whale deposits to Binance hit six‑month highs and futures open interest rose above pre‑vote levels as price moved with a broader crypto risk‑on rally.
XRPUSD saw a sharp derivatives vs spot split: $5.51B in futures vs $1.29B spot volume; futures open interest about $3.05B, signaling heavy leverage and greater derivatives liquidity.
XRPUSD saw a $5.15M ETF outflow Thursday, the biggest daily outflow since Sept. 2. Exchange XRP reserves fell to ~1.7B, a seven-year low, shrinking on-exchange supply.
Evernorth got $30M convertible-note funding from NH Investment to buy XRP spot, boosting XRPUSD spot holdings ahead of a planned Nasdaq listing via a SPAC merger.
XRPUSD hit its weakest two-week RSI in 13 years, signaling short-term momentum loss; price still sits on a long-term ascending support line spanning multiple market cycles.
Long-term target $11 for XRPUSD; near term focus is holding key support zones to build strength over weeks to months. $11 is a distant possible target, not imminent.
Trader positioning for XRPUSD showed bullish tilt: long-to-short ratios ~2.37 on Binance (2.76 for top traders) and ~2.13 on OKX during an XRP price spike.
